   Therapeutic relevance: Are there targeted therapies for NF1 mutations in glioblastoma? NF1 loss leads to RAS pathway activation, but MEK inhibitors, for example, are not standard in glioblastoma. No specific approval. So, Therapeutic relevance: No. Confidence: high.

   Therapeutic relevance: Are there targeted therapies for MDM2 amplification in glioblastoma? MDM2 inhibitors are in clinical trials but not approved for glioblastoma. So, no standard therapy. Therapeutic relevance: No. Confidence: high.
